title: Latent generative search unlocks de novo design of untapped biomolecular interactions at scale.
authors: Didi, Kieran; Reidenbach, Danny; Penner, Matthew; Ravichandran, Supriya; Case, Marshall; Nichols, Mike; Swanson, Erik; Reis, Alex; Prescott, Maggie; Qian, Yue; Qian, Dongming; Yang, Jingjing; Li, Weiji; Li, Le; Shonai, Daichi; Gay, Sean; Basu Mallik, Bhoomika; Chim, Ho Yeung; Chen, Liurong; Atienza Juanatey, Miguel; Klein, Hubert; Rieger, Dominic; Schlegel, Phillip; Macintyre, Anna U; Secor, Maxim; Granata, Daniele; Cha, Sooyoung; Cao, Zhonglin; Zhou, Guoqing; Geffner, Tomas; Chen, Xi; Livne, Micha; Zhang, Zuobai; Zhang, Tianjing; Gion, Kyle; Bronstein, Michael M; Steinegger, Martin; Deibler, Kristine; Soderling, Scott; Schoeder, Clara T; Khmelinskaia, Alena; Hollfelder, Florian; Dallago, Christian; Kucukbenli, Emine; Vahdat, Arash; Ogden, Pierce; Kreis, Karsten
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文提出潜在生成搜索框架，利用奖励引导的推理时搜索驱动Proteina-Complexa生成模型协同设计蛋白序列与结构，实现从头设计针对极性表位和柔性配体的高亲和力结合蛋白，直接推进蛋白质结构计算设计方法。
abstract: De novo protein design has advanced rapidly, yet designing binders to polar, solvent-exposed epitopes and small, flexible ligands remains challenging. Such hydrated surfaces and flexible molecules, including carbohydrates, provide few of the hydrophobic contacts favoured by current methods and have largely resisted de novo binders. To address this challenge, here we introduce latent generative search for binder design, a novel framework that uses reward-guided search at inference time to steer the Proteina-Complexa generative model. The model codesigns sequence and structure - generating them together in a continuous latent space - and thereby removes the inverse-folding step on which current methods rely. In a screen of more than one million designs by multiplexed phage display, latent generative search produced more validated binders than every other method tested, its codesigned sequences surpassing post hoc redesign. It delivered high-affinity binders across therapeutic receptors, a viral attachment protein and intracellular signalling targets. Our approach also accessed previously untapped biology, generating the first de novo proteins that bind a free carbohydrate, including one that discriminates between blood-group antigens - a polar, flexible target class beyond the reach of current design methods.
abstract_zh: 从头设计蛋白质已取得快速进展，但针对极性、溶剂暴露表位以及小型柔性配体的结合剂设计仍具挑战性。此类水合表面和柔性分子（包括碳水化合物）提供的疏水接触较少，而当前方法偏好这些接触，因此大多难以实现从头结合剂的设计。为应对这一挑战，我们在此引入用于结合剂设计的潜在生成搜索（latent generative search），这是一种新颖框架，在推理时利用奖励引导搜索来引导Proteina-Complexa生成模型。该模型协同设计序列和结构——在连续潜在空间中同时生成二者——从而消除了当前方法所依赖的逆折叠步骤。在通过多重噬菌体展示筛选超过一百万个设计的实验中，潜在生成搜索产生的验证结合剂数量超过所有其他测试方法，其协同设计的序列优于事后重设计。它提供了针对治疗性受体、病毒附着蛋白和细胞内信号靶点的高亲和力结合剂。我们的方法还触及了此前未开发的生物学领域，生成了首个能结合游离碳水化合物的从头蛋白质，其中包括一种能区分血型抗原的结合剂——这是一个极性、柔性的靶标类别，超出了当前设计方法的能力范围。
